title: Treat cross-layer cache accounting changes as one atomic state contract

source.title: SGLang PR #38163 unified-KV/SWA accounting revert
source.claim_scope: The source proves a broad merged revert, not the root cause; use as a state-contract warning.

implementation_recipe: Write one invariant table spanning scheduler estimates, allocator ownership, ring position and model pool layout.
Change and test every producer/consumer of each accounting field atomically.
Keep rollback and migration behavior explicit.
validation_recipe: Compare estimated and actual allocation over extend, decode, reuse and wraparound.
Exercise state restoration and disaggregated lifecycle transitions.
Run invariant checks under capacity pressure.
expected_bottleneck_shifts: A local capacity or memory saving can create remote scheduler or lifecycle corruption if the shared state contract diverges.
failure_modes: Only the allocator or only the scheduler adopts the new accounting.
SWA wraparound and reuse are omitted from tests.
A broad change merges without a reversible staged rollout.
scope_limits: The captured revert does not identify which invariant failed, so the card cannot prescribe a specific implementation.

candidate_archetypes.name: cross-layer accounting contract migration
candidate_archetypes.template: Define the shared accounting equation first, update every layer atomically, and gate rollout on lifecycle invariants.
